result.defense: A fully solves the arithmetic for the tablet founder: at 768 the sidebar becomes the existing drawer, main returns to 768px with a full-width composer, and the panel overlays at 384px; at 1440 the 480px MIN_CHAT_WIDTH caps the panel at 644px, leaving exactly 480px for chat, with stored widths already clamped through min(maxWidth, preferred). result.defense:
Proposal A solves the exact arithmetic root cause with maximum surgical precision and minimal risk in an 8,622-line Shell.tsx. By moving the sidebar dock breakpoint from md (768px) to lg (1024px) via a single shared DOCKED_SIDEBAR_QUERY constant, moving the right panel dock breakpoint from md (768px) to xl (1280px) with max-xl:shadow-xl, raising MIN_CHAT_WIDTH from 320px to 480px, and stacking the Models overlay below 900px, Proposal A satisfies every acceptance criterion using the app's existing drawer and overlay patterns. For a naive first-time founder on a 768px tablet or small laptop, the main workspace immediately gets the full 768px width (up from a crushed 132px) without introducing unfamiliar layout mechanics.

Against Proposal B: Proposal B over-engineers a CSS breakpoint problem into a JavaScript ResizeObserver hook (useShellLayout) and custom data-attribute selectors across Shell.tsx. Worse for usability, B's dynamic width budget auto-collapses the left navigation sidebar when the user opens a right panel around 1000px, which is disorienting for a first-time founder whose primary navigation suddenly disappears, and introduces state-persistence hazards and resize layout thrashing.

Against Proposal C: Proposal C shares A's exact breakpoint foundation but widens the overlay panel from 384px to 480px (obscuring 62% of a 768px tablet screen), adds a modal scrim that blocks referencing or scrolling the main column alongside the panel on 1024px-1279px laptops, and adds custom Escape/focus handling that collides with the VIS-03 keyboard lane. Taking A as the foundation and grafting only C's on-load restoration clamp (below 1280px) and header toggle pressed state delivers the best usability and visual clarity at a fraction of the risk.
